title: Sponson release plan (release.plan.yaml)
description: One release, one plan. Specification: docs/plan-format.md. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express (unique ids, references to existing ids, declared environments) are enforced by `sponson plan`.

environments.description: Environments this plan knows. Default: preview, production, plus every environment a line names. `--env` must be one of them.

providers.description: Static configuration per adapter, passed to it as `providers.<adapter>`.

vercel.description: Vercel project (`prj_…`) and, for team projects, the team id (`team_…`).

clerk.description: Clerk needs no provider configuration; the instance is the one CLERK_SECRET_KEY belongs to.

receipts.description: Receipt store. Default git-branch (orphan branches `sponson-receipts/<env>/<scope>` on the `origin` remote). `--receipts` overrides it.

changes.description: The plan lines. Order in the file does not matter: execution order follows `from:` references and `depends_on`.

id.description: Lowercase: letters, digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter.

secretRef.description: A secret reference, resolved only inside Sponson, e.g. `{ secret: "env://NAME" }`. Schemes: docs/plan-format.md#secret-schemes.

keepRef.description: Whatever value the resource has live. Written by `sponson init` when adopting.

value.description: A literal, `{ from }`, `{ secret }` or `{ keep: true }`.

noDisplayText.description: Text `sponson plan` prints for unresolved values must never be written back into the plan.

notSecretLiteral.description: Names ending in _KEY, _SECRET, _TOKEN, PASSWORD, _PASS, PASSWD or PRIVATE (any case) take a `{ secret }` reference, not a literal string or number.

param.description: Any adapter parameter: a literal, a reference, a list, or a map. Applied recursively.

adapter.description: Built in: neon, vercel, clerk. Plugins (SPONSON_PLUGINS) add more.

environments.description: Environments this line applies to. Absent: all.

depends_on.description: Ordering without a data dependency. Prefer `from:` references.

paramsOfChange.description: Every key other than id, adapter, op, environments and depends_on is a parameter of the op.

op_neon_branch.description: neon.branch: a Neon branch. Outputs: branch_id, connection_string (sensitive), host.

parent.description: Parent branch name or id. Default: main.

name.description: Branch name. Default: sponson/${ctx.env}/${ctx.scope}. The branch is identified by its name.

op_vercel_env.description: vercel.env: environment variables in one Vercel target (and, for preview, one git branch). Outputs: preview_url and deployment_id, available after the deploy.

target.description: preview, production or development. Default: production when --env production, else preview.

branch.description: Git branch the variables apply to (target preview only). Default: the current branch. `*` means project-wide (every branch).

values.description: NAME: value. A value is a literal, `{ from }`, `{ secret }` or `{ keep: true }`.

op_vercel_deploy.description: vercel.deploy: a deployment of the current commit, made by Sponson. Outputs: preview_url, deployment_id (immediate). Takes no parameters.

op_clerk_redirect_allow.description: clerk.redirect_allow: one allowed redirect URL. Output: id.

url.description: The URL to allow. Usually `{ from: <vercel.env line>.preview_url }`.
